claude.goal: Implement login, /api/me and the current-user helper in src/auth.

produces.text: POST /api/login with {email,password} returns 200 {token} (random opaque token stored in store.sessions). Clients send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>. GET /api/me returns 200 {id,email} for a valid bearer token, 401 otherwise. No cookies are set.

src/auth/index.js exports requireUser(req, res, next): reads Authorization: Bearer <token>, sets req.user = {id,email} and calls next(); responds 401 {error} when the header is missing or the token is unknown.

claude.notes: Bearer tokens are my tentative default; I can switch to a cookie if the UI needs it.

codex.goal: Implement public/app.js: log in from the form, then register for the event and show the status.

requires.text: POST /api/login sets an httpOnly session cookie; same-origin fetch sends it automatically, so the UI never stores or sends a token.
POST /api/events/<data-event-id>/registrations with no body returns 201 on success and 409 if already registered; 401 when not logged in.

codex.notes: Cookie session is my tentative default.

produces.text: POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations (no body). 201 {id,eventId,userId} with a new UUID id; 409 {error} if this user is already registered; 404 {error} for an unknown event; 401 {error} when not logged in.

requires.text: A middleware exported from src/auth/index.js that sets req.user {id,email} or responds 401.

claude.goal: Implement auth with an httpOnly cookie session.

produces.text: POST /api/login sets an httpOnly cookie sid=<random id> and returns 200 {id,email}; GET /api/me returns 200 {id,email} from the cookie, 401 without it.
src/auth/index.js exports getCurrentUser(req): returns {id,email} or null. Callers decide how to respond.
